name: NREL UAE Phase VI blade - mass, centre of gravity, modal frequencies (measured) and estimated distributed structural properties

experiments.validates: blade mass and first mass moment (-> centrifugal root force) of Calculator.statical_analysis when fed this blade's mass distribution (or an equivalent density/wall); the measured mass/CG check the estimate of Table A-9
experiments.conditions: blade 3, standard tip, probe plugs inserted; weighed
experiments.source: Hand et al. 2001, NREL/TP-500-29955, Appendix A p. 75, tabulated
experiments.uncertainty: not stated in the source (weighing; assume +-0.1 kg, +-5 mm)

experiments.validates: reference input for a future deflection/frequency solver; order-of-magnitude check of the homogeneous section model (composite blade)
experiments.conditions: ESTIMATED by NREL (code + material properties), not measured; integrates to 57.3 kg for r >= 0.508 m vs 60.2 kg weighed
experiments.source: Hand et al. 2001, Table A-9 (p. 76), tabulated
experiments.uncertainty: estimate; the report notes the predicted frequencies did not match the measured ones (pitch-shaft modelling)

experiments.validates: a future modal/deflection solver (not in the program yet)
experiments.conditions: non-rotating, blade on a dummy pitch shaft clamped at the bearings
experiments.source: Hand et al. 2001, Table A-10 (p. 79), tabulated

sources.citation: Hand, M.M., Simms, D.A., Fingersh, L.J., Jager, D.W., Cotrell, J.R., Schreck, S., Larwood, S.M. (2001). Unsteady Aerodynamics Experiment Phase VI: Wind Tunnel Test Configurations and Available Data Campaigns. NREL/TP-500-29955.

notes: Structural companion of the aerodynamic case nrel_phase_vi (same rotor; geometry, airfoils and the MEASURED ROOT FLAP/EDGE MOMENTS vs wind speed are in ../nrel_phase_vi, experiment/loads.csv, gauge_r_m = 0.432 m - not duplicated here). Blade: carbon-fibre D-spar + fibreglass skin + aramid honeycomb (Fig. A-9), so a homogeneous solid/hollow section reproduces it only with fitted properties. r < 1.257 m in Table A-9 is the steel pitch shaft (80 mm cylinder at the gauges, r = 0.432 m), aluminium root insert and blade root cylinder. Other measured mass data on p. 75: rotor 577.3 kg, hub 237.8 kg, pitch-shaft hardware 38.6 kg per blade, tip plate +2.41 kg, blade extension +2.47 kg vs the standard tip.
